GAP_ANALYSIS_AC_AMENDMENT: Concurrent fixture must use OS processes (not threads)

Amend AC to add:
- Fixture spawns N>=3 independent OS processes (not threads, not asyncio) — fcntl.flock is per-process, thread-based test would falsely pass
- Assert final cycles[] length == N, all n values present exactly once (no overwrites)
- Assert file is valid JSON at every intermediate step (no torn writes → verifies atomic rename pattern)
- Recommend: use subprocess.Popen or shell '&' + 'wait' to spawn multiple processes
